lede: Nebraska carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.5 against -1.2, a 2.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Michigan State -1.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Michigan State winning 53% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
